name: Nethouse Leads
author: nethouse

sections.description:
Nethouse Leads helps you get more leads from your site without raising your ad budget. Build widgets, quizzes and live chats in a visual builder, no coding needed. All requests go to the built-in CRM automatically, and web push notifications bring visitors back to the site.

Widgets

Lead forms, popups, banners, multi-buttons, polls and other widgets to collect contacts and make sales. 20+ ready-made templates, custom design and display conditions. Chain several widgets to show them one after another.

Quizzes

Interactive quizzes that help visitors choose a product or service and leave their contacts. Linear and branching scenarios, various question types, logic check and preview before publishing.

Live chat

Talk to site visitors and answer their questions in real time. Assign operators, track dialog status and view visitor details. New message notifications arrive by email, in Telegram, in Max and in the browser.

Web push

Send notifications straight to subscribers’ browsers, even after they have left the site. Announce sales, new products and important news to bring your audience back without email or SMS campaigns.

CRM

A free CRM to track leads and work with clients. Requests from widgets, quizzes and chat are collected automatically. Track deals in a table or on a kanban board.

Features

  • Visual editor, no coding needed
  • Flexible display conditions: by time, visitor actions, pages and devices
  • Integration with Yandex Metrica, third-party CRMs and other services via webhooks
  • Instant notifications about new leads and messages
  • Overall and detailed statistics for every tool

Why Nethouse Leads

  • More leads from your current site traffic
  • All lead generation tools in one service
  • Quick start without complex setup
  • Built-in CRM to track and process leads

How it works

Widgets are created and managed in the Nethouse Leads dashboard. The plugin adds the Nethouse Leads script to the pages of your site; which widgets are shown and where is set in the dashboard.

A Nethouse account is required.

External services

The plugin relies on Nethouse Leads, a service by Nethouse, to show the widgets and send web push notifications. Nothing is sent until you paste a code in the plugin settings.

Once the widget installation code is saved, every page of the site loads the script https://leads.nethouse.ru/static/leads.js in the visitor’s browser. The script requests the widget settings for your site from leads.nethouse.ru, and sends there:

  • widget views and clicks, for the statistics in your dashboard;
  • what a visitor enters into a widget (forms, quizzes, chats), when they submit it, together with the page the visit started on, its UTM tags, the referring domain and the device type (mobile or desktop).

The script keeps the visit details and a widget view counter in the visitor’s browser storage (sessionStorage and localStorage).

If the code includes «No flicker for Smart content», a small inline script on every page also requests the settings for your site from leads.nethouse.ru and opens connections to leads.nethouse.ru, s2.siteapi.org and i.siteapi.org (Nethouse servers for widget images).

Once the web push connection code is saved, every page of the site loads the script https://leads.nethouse.ru/static/webpush-sdk.js, which requests the web push settings for your site from leads.nethouse.ru. When a visitor allows notifications in the browser, the push subscription is sent to leads.nethouse.ru together with the browser, operating system, device type, language and time zone. The service worker reports to leads.nethouse.ru when a notification is delivered, shown or clicked, and renews the subscription when the browser changes it. Nothing is sent about visitors who don’t subscribe, apart from loading the settings.

  • Service: https://leads.nethouse.ru/
  • Terms of use and personal data processing: https://nethouse.ru/agreement
sections.installation:
1. Upload the nethouse-leads folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory, or install the plugin through the Plugins screen in WordPress.
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins screen in WordPress.
  3. In the Nethouse Leads dashboard press «Code» and copy the code from the section for sites on other CMS.
  4. Open Settings → Nethouse Leads, paste the code into the Installation code field as is and save.

To send web push notifications:

  1. In the Nethouse Leads dashboard open the web push project, tab «Connection», and copy the code from the step «Connect and initialize the SDK». Paste it into the Web push → Connection code field.
  2. In «Domain verification» choose «Meta tag», copy the tag and paste it into the Web push → Domain verification field.
  3. Save. You don’t need to upload webpush-sw.js to the site root: the plugin serves the service worker itself.
sections.faq:
Which widgets will be shown?

The ones the copied code is for: the code from the widget list shows all widgets enabled in the dashboard, the code from a widget’s page shows only that widget. To change it, copy the code you need in the dashboard and paste it again.

Where is the web push service worker?

The plugin serves it from the address of your site with ?nethouse-leads-sw=1, so it works without access to the site root and with any permalink settings.

How do I get rid of the flicker with Smart content?

Tick «No flicker for Smart content» in the dashboard before copying the code. The page is then covered with a white screen until the change is applied (up to 1.5 s on the first screen), so visitors don’t see the original content flicker.
